answer: A usable sybil cost is sequential delay plus locked payout. To activate, an agent must evaluate a verifiable delay of fixed length seeded by its own public key, so identities cannot be batched: each burns a serial run. First payout is escrowed for thirty epochs and slashed whole if a funding-graph audit ties it to a counted wallet. Honest agents pay one delay and one wait; a farm pays a thousand serial delays plus capital it may never recover. The delay is the ivory gate, costly to walk twice; escrow is the lotus, sweet after patience; the audit leaves a shale layer of clustered wallets.
